title: 第26章 突破通玄境第27章 围猎开始
content_zh:
夜深且寒。
楚夏离开兰溪殿的时候，已经是后半夜。
可算是把他累坏了。
给夏蓝曦搓澡就不说了，这事倒不算什么，有手就行。
但是在不引人注意的情况下將小然送回兰溪殿，可是废了他不小的功夫。
楚夏尤其担心被他老嬤嬤给撞见。
好在一切顺利。
哪怕有什么遗漏，至少查不到楚夏身上来。
查到也没关係，楚夏明面上毕竟还是夏紫萱的人。
皇族的明爭暗斗犹如家常便饭一样，你来我往，实属正常。
返回紫月殿后，楚夏本打算泡个澡再休息，可一回来就看到，夏紫萱瞪著个眼睛坐在床上，居然还没睡。
“这么晚不睡你修仙呢。”楚夏调笑道。
看到楚夏如此轻鬆自如的神情，夏紫萱终於鬆了口气。
他都会贫嘴了，说明今晚行动一切顺利。
“画像呢？”
楚夏打开储物袋，將皇后孟婉晴的画像拿了出来。
夏紫萱惊喜万分，扑上来就要取走画像。
楚夏却故意將画像高高举起。
“我可是冒著生命危险帮你偷来了画像，长公主连个谢字都吝嗇说出口嘛？”
夏紫萱瞥了楚夏一眼，隨后一脸娇羞的搂住楚夏的脖子，娇滴滴的说道：“楚夏哥哥，谢谢你啦，你人真好。”

噫……
楚夏鸡皮疙瘩都竖起来了。
连忙將手里的画像塞给了夏紫萱。
“还欠我一个条件，別忘了。”
楚夏说完便去了沐浴室，舒舒服服泡起澡来。
……
三天后。
地下室里，灵气氤氳翻腾。
伴隨著一阵灵气激盪，楚夏整个人的气息都发生了翻天覆地的变化。
“终於突破通玄境了！”
楚夏睁开双眼，露出十分满意的微笑。
所谓通玄，是指人体经脉中的一处主要穴位，通玄穴。
content_en:
The night is late and cold.
It was already late at night when Chu Xia left Lanxi Palace.
It can be said that he was exhausted.
Let's not talk about giving Xia Lanxi a bath. It's not a big deal, as long as you have the skills.
But sending Xiaoran back to Lanxi Palace without attracting attention wasted a lot of effort on his part.
Chu Xia was especially worried about being caught by his old nanny.
Fortunately everything went well.
Even if there were any omissions, at least they wouldn't be traced to Chu Xia.
It doesn't matter if he finds out, Chu Xia Ming is still Xia Zixuan's person after all.
The royal family's overt and covert fights are commonplace, and it's normal for you to come and go.
After returning to Ziyue Palace, Chu Xia planned to take a bath and rest, but when she came back, she saw Xia Zixuan sitting on the bed with her eyes wide open, and she was still awake.
"You stay up so late to cultivate immortality." Chu Xia teased.
Seeing Chu Xia's relaxed expression, Xia Zixuan finally breathed a sigh of relief.
He will be talkative, which means that tonight's operation went well.
"Where's the portrait?"
Chu Xia opened the storage bag and took out the portrait of Queen Meng Wanqing.
Xia Zixuan was so surprised that she rushed to take away the portrait.
Chu Xia deliberately raised the portrait high.
"I risked my life to help you steal the portrait, but the eldest princess is so stingy about saying thank you?"
Xia Zixuan glanced at Chu Xia, then hugged Chu Xia's neck with a shy look, and said sweetly: "Brother Chu Xia, thank you, you are so kind."
Ugh...
Chu Xia's goosebumps stood up.
He quickly handed the portrait in his hand to Xia Zixuan.
"You still owe me a condition, don't forget it."
After Chu Xia finished speaking, she went to the bathroom and took a comfortable bath.
…
Three days later.
In the basement, spiritual energy was stirring.
Along with a surge of spiritual energy, Chu Xia's entire aura underwent earth-shaking changes.
"Finally broke through to the Tongxuan realm!"
Chu Xia opened her eyes and showed a very satisfied smile.
The so-called Tongxuan refers to a major acupoint in the human body’s meridians, Tongxuan.
